title: AnalyticsBeacon
description: What a site's first-party analytics script sends to POST /__cloudhal/e (RFC-0006): JSON as text/plain, at most 2 KB. Everything in it is untrusted. The server keeps a beacon only after the same-origin, bot and rate checks, normalises the path and resolves it to a published route, reduces the referrer to a host, normalises UTM values, and derives everything else (node, country, device, visitor) itself. The script never sends an identifier, a cookie or a full URL.

oneOf.title: AnalyticsPageviewBeacon
oneOf.description: Sent once per page view, when the page is first visible (after prerendering, and again on a back/forward cache restore).

referrer.description: The host of document.referrer only (the script drops scheme, path and query); empty or absent for direct visits.

oneOf.title: AnalyticsVitalsBeacon
oneOf.description: Sent once, when a sampled page view is hidden, with the Core Web Vitals measured so far.

sampleOneIn.description: The vitals sampling the script was served with (one page view in N); the server checks it against the site's setting.

BeaconPath.description: location.pathname as the browser reports it (no query string, no fragment).

BeaconUtm.description: A raw utm_* value from the page URL; the server lower-cases it and drops it unless it fits the stored alphabet.
